endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: wa_wdfw_heller_bar_ramp_access_anchor_20260918 riverbrain-heller-bar-boat-ramp-takeout-corroborated-by-wdfw-water-access-site: RiverBrain's Heller Bar Boat Ramp record publishes the exact shared endpoint coordinate, identifies it as a take-out/launch, and describes a concrete ramp, toilets, and parking. The managing agency WDFW independently confirms a year-round Heller Bar public access site with a concrete ramp and hand launch; its official GIS site point is about 103 feet from the exact RiverBrain ramp point. WDFW reports that the gravel bar in front of the ramp is exposed at lower summer flows, so the ramp-to-water interface varies. American Whitewater also lists Heller Bar but its marker is about 950 feet from the shared coordinate and is not a defensible replacement for the exact ramp point. Retain the RiverBrain ramp coordinate as an access anchor and leave the hydrography offset visible for review.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (wa_wdfw_heller_bar_ramp_access_anchor_20260918 riverbrain-heller-bar-boat-ramp-takeout-corroborated-by-wdfw-water-access-site) on Snake River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
